description: The execai agent in your sidebar: streaming chat, tools with confirmations, file and selection context. Works in VS Code and Cursor.
cmd.sendSelection: ExecAI: Send the selection to the agent
cmd.attachFile: ExecAI: Attach a file to the chat
cfg.binaryPath: Path to the execai binary. Empty or "execai" — the extension finds it in PATH or fetches it itself.
cfg.maxIterations: Tool iteration limit per turn (0 — take it from the execai config).
cfg.attachContext: Attach the active file and selection to the message.
cfg.autoInstall: Offer to download the execai agent when it is missing or outdated.
